answer: Make storage the identity test: every agent must anchor a distinct 512 MB data vault, tagged with a non-transferable jade audit key. Every 6 hours the network sends a random byte-range proof due within 90 seconds, and shard sets never overlap, so one proof cannot serve two identities. An operator running 200 fakes must hold 102.4 GB and answer 200 proofs; 3 misses in 30 days revoke the identity and its rewards.
